rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a very poor-quality early blastocyst/1DD, noting absent-poor ICM and sparse TE, but it over-interprets some image details and is somewhat inconsistent about stage (full/expanded vs early/half-cavitating).

Integrates age 39, prior IVF failures, biochemical pregnancy, BMI, endometrium, ovarian response, and semen parameters well, though AMH is unavailable and the male-factor discussion is somewhat speculative.

Overall logic is clear: poor morphology plus age and repeated failure lowers prognosis. Minor inconsistencies remain around exact blastocyst stage and probability phrasing, but conclusions are broadly supported.

Mostly aligned with standard IVF counseling and Gardner-based interpretation, but there are some deviations/speculations such as discussing fresh transfer and PGT-A somewhat loosely in a low-yield setting, and slight grading imprecision.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer, luteal support, uterine cavity evaluation, protocol review, and future-cycle planning; recommendations are useful though not highly tailored to all missing clinical details.
